source: University of Hamburg · English Explorations · Basic concepts of English phonetics and pronunciation
description: Isolated English phoneme demonstrations, stored locally. The ks cluster joins the recorded k and s sounds after removing boundary silence. It is not the letter name ex. Each sound challenge plays its phoneme twice, with a 550 ms gap after the first clip.
instruction: What letter makes this sound? · en-US-AnaNeural; no IPA is passed to TTS.
